g.text: A = asymmetry index |EDF_yx - EDF_xy| / (EDF_yx + EDF_xy), in [0, 1]
EDF = effective degrees of freedom of the smooth
Shape glyph = objective shape category (see shape-types legend below)
Cell border encodes non-linearity, EDF - 1 (see right-margin legend)
